answer: A photojournalist assignment log is the credential: assignments logged with one agency across years of front lines. Each of 532 aliases needs its own authority-backed record, and the live check behind each one makes bulk forgery cost more than the reward. The registry is consulted again every epoch, and a record that does not match the issuer's own books ends the seat. The thread check runs in the open: 532 fakes pay the full price 532 times, one honest agent pays once, and the nectar trail in the ledger makes the violet cost visible to everyone.
